title: HealthLoopQA: A Context-Aware Question Answering Benchmark for Interpreting Wearable Monitoring Data in Diabetes Care
abstract: arXiv:2609.06976v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As medical wearables become integrated into daily chronic disease care, effectively interpreting longitudinal monitoring data is essential for patients and clinicians to understand health trends, detect safety-critical events, and make informed decisions. While large language models (LLMs) show promise for transforming this streaming physiological data into personalized health insights, evaluating their reasoning capability and analytical rigor in diverse monitoring tasks remains a fundamental challenge. Existing medical wearable question answering (QA) benchmarks primarily assess short-horizon classification or statistical summaries, largely ignoring the long-term patterns, therapeutic and behavioural contexts, and potential system failures inherent in real-world deployments. To address this, we introduce HealthLoopQA, a comprehensive diagnostic benchmark for evaluating LLM reasoning over continuous diabetes monitoring data. Grounded in

translated_title: HealthLoopQA：一个用于解读糖尿病护理中可穿戴监测数据的情境感知问答基准
translated_abstract: 随着医疗可穿戴设备日益融入日常慢性病护理，有效解读纵向监测数据对于患者和临床医生理解健康趋势、检测安全关键事件以及做出明智决策至关重要。尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）在将这类流式生理数据转化为个性化健康洞察方面展现出前景，但评估其在多样化监测任务中的推理能力和分析严谨性仍然是一项根本性挑战。现有的医疗可穿戴问答（QA）基准主要评估短期分类或统计摘要，在很大程度上忽略了现实世界部署中固有的长期模式、治疗和行为情境以及潜在的系统故障。为解决这一问题，我们提出了HealthLoopQA，一个用于评估大型语言模型在连续糖尿病监测数据上推理能力的综合诊断性基准。
tldr: 该论文提出了HealthLoopQA，一个情境感知的综合诊断基准，用于评估大型语言模型在解读糖尿病连续可穿戴监测数据方面的推理能力，弥补了现有基准忽视长期模式、治疗行为情境和真实部署中系统故障的不足。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces HealthLoopQA, a context-aware diagnostic benchmark for evaluating LLM reasoning over continuous diabetes monitoring data, addressing the limitations of existing benchmarks that overlook long-term patterns, therapeutic and behavioral contexts, and potential system failures in real-world deployments.
